Chapter VI · For privacy-first recruiters
## Sharing, on  
your _terms._
Contributing doesn't mean handing over your pipeline. Every profile you share stays yours first, and you decide how it gets chosen.
[Get Started Free](https://olibr.com/register)[Read the questions](https://olibr.com/#faq)
01
30 Days Private
A profile you contribute stays private to your company for 30 days — and another 14 days if you are still working with that candidate.
02
Only What Counts
Profiles Olibr already has never count, so you are not asked to share the same candidate twice. Incomplete profiles don't count either.
03
Approve Once, Stop Anytime
Approve automatic contribution once and we handle each month. Turn it off whenever you like and contribute by hand instead.
Q&A column · No. 22
## The honest  
questions, _answered._
If it's not answered here, write to us at support@olibr.com — we reply within 24 hours.
i.Why is Olibr free?+
Because recruiters pay in candidate profiles instead of invoices. Each company contributes 50 candidate profiles per active user every 30 days, and in return the ATS, job board, candidate search and your whole team are free. Only AI features cost money, from a wallet you top up.
ii.Who can see the profiles I contribute?+
Only your company, for 30 days — and another 14 days if you are still working with that candidate. After that the profile joins Olibr's shared talent pool, where other recruiters can find it. Profiles Olibr already has don't count toward your total, so you are never asked to share the same candidate twice.
iii.Can I use Olibr without contributing profiles?+
No. Contribution is what keeps Olibr free for everyone, and there is no paid plan that replaces it. If your database runs short, upload CVs or import a spreadsheet to top it up.
iv.What does Olibr include, and what is paid?+
Free: ATS, job board, candidate search, AI matching, team collaboration, the browser extension, and sending skill assessments on your own test platform. Paid from your wallet: AI interviews ₹99 each, branded resume PDFs ₹5 each, resume parsing ₹5 per CV after the first 50, and LinkedIn AI content ₹499 a month.
v.How many profiles are available?+
Currently 180,000+ profiles and growing. Every recruiter who joins contributes profiles from their existing database, continuously expanding the shared talent network for everyone.
